# FROZEN FIXTURE.  Generated by pg_mkcorpus.py.

# GRAMMAR:
#   SPAN <id> i= ipart= fpart= tinta= escr= flares= cull= half= maxy=
#             tex= uv=u0,v0;u1,v1;... pre=
#
# uv[] is the ORDERED list of the row's (u,v) values as int32: pair 0 is
# the value computed at `trace` before the first block, pair k>=1 is the
# value after block k's `fistp u / fistp v`.  Block k reads pair k-1 into
# EAX/EDX and derives its per-pixel step as (pair[k]-pair[k-1]) >> 4,
# a 32-bit arithmetic shift; the accumulators themselves are 16-BIT
# (`add ax,bp` carries no 0x66 prefix).
#
# TEXTURES (formulas over the 64 KiB window reachable through fs:[bx]):
#   TEX0  t[i] = (i*37 + 11) & 255
#   TEX1  t[i] = ((i>>8) ^ (i & 255)) & 255
#   TEX2  t[i] = 1
#   TEX3  t[i] = 0 except t[0]=t[32768]=t[65535]=255
#
# escr defaults to 0xE0.  The two scratch pixels adapted[63996]/[63997]
# (es:[0xFA00]/[0xFA01]) carry tinta and escrescenze and are present in
# every case as a canary.
